snippet.title: K.O. King PS2 Full Playthrough (Phoenix Games) 1/3
snippet.description:
Ko King is another strange & basic Phoenix game on the PS2. This time its a boxing game that actually looks pretty promising. When the game loads into the title screen you see an extra level of effort has been used that you dont usually see in phoenix games, so that was a nice suprise. However when the actual game loads were back to the same budget gameplay we expect from phoenix. 

Its not a terrible game, but it has its flaws. Compared to other boxing games this one wont be able to stand on its own 2 feet. But i can see how small children would of gotten some enjoyment from it, for a short while. 

The controls are janky and sometimes unresponsive, and every character knocked down gets up at 2 seconds left. Its lierally just a button mash and pray you dont fall over, which doesnt happen often anyway. 

One thing i noticed was that the better you do, the more the cpu will attack, so quick jabs were enough to keep the cpu dumb and win every time! 

Contined in part 2....
